method: Reuse the digest-bound direct-call census; verify both literal references per caller FDE. For hyperliquidChain, require the exact 49-byte sequence from the 0xb0 marker through capacity branch, literal store, writer update, and direct-call argument setup.
limitations: FDE containment is not a source-function name or owner attribution.
The records establish literal loads and stores in each containing FDE; they do not establish a Rust type, protocol semantics, or runtime network selection.
Indirect calls, tail jumps, code outside file-backed .text, and FDE-less code are not covered.
